### Relationships Between Modifications
The modifications in both files are closely related as they work together to address the issue of memory access ordering on the Alpha architecture. The changes in `io.h` define the interface for the read operations and their relaxed counterparts, while the changes in `io.c` provide the implementation of these functions. The introduction of memory barriers in both files ensures that the read operations are properly ordered with respect to each other, preventing potential hangs or incorrect behavior when performing I/O operations. This cohesive approach rectifies the issues introduced by previous commits that altered the barrier placements, thereby restoring correct functionality on the Alpha Avanti platform.
